reason: My bookkeeper and I already run everything through Zoho Expense and it works well enough, so I don't want a second system next to it. The Telegram screenshots are annoying, but my bookkeeper already deals with them and I'm not going to move my whole setup to a new bot for that.
objection: This is a small new bot. If it shuts down in six months I've got a half-finished sheet and staff who've changed their habits for nothing, and I'm back on Zoho anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If it sent the checked receipts straight into Zoho or Jurnal, so it only replaces the part where my bookkeeper digs through Telegram and my main app stays the same.
